questions.question: True or False: Brighton & Hove Albion defeated Arsenal 3–0 at the American Express Stadium in September 2026.
questions.anchorClues: Brighton & Hove Albion recorded an impressive 3–0 home victory over Arsenal on 19 September 2026.

questions.question: Manchester City defeated Sunderland 5–3 at the Etihad Stadium in September 2026. How many total goals were scored in the match?
questions.anchorClues: Manchester City's 5–3 win over Sunderland yielded 8 goals at the Etihad Stadium on 20 September 2026.

questions.question: During September 2026 matchweek fixtures, Brentford recorded a 3–0 home victory over which London rival?
questions.anchorClues: Brentford defeated Chelsea 3–0 at the Gtech Community Stadium on 18 September 2026.

questions.question: Which manager was at the helm for Newcastle United during their iconic 5–0 victory over Manchester United in October 1996?
questions.anchorClues: Kevin Keegan famously managed Newcastle United to a 5–0 win over Manchester United at St James' Park on 20 October 1996.

questions.question: Who scored the final Premier League goal at Highbury before Arsenal moved to the Emirates Stadium in May 2006?
questions.anchorClues: Thierry Henry completed a hat-trick against Wigan Athletic on 7 May 2006, scoring the final goal ever at Highbury.

questions.question: Which club holds the Premier League record for going an entire 38-match season without a single home victory?
questions.anchorClues: Sunderland failed to win a home match during the 2005–06 season, finishing with 0 wins, 3 draws, and 16 defeats at the Stadium of Light.

questions.question: Which player came off the bench in the 72nd minute and scored four goals in 20 minutes against Nottingham Forest in February 1999?
questions.anchorClues: Ole Gunnar Solskjær scored four times as a substitute during Manchester United's 8–1 win at the City Ground on 6 February 1999.

questions.question: Which goalkeeper saved three penalties for Hull City during the 2016–17 Premier League season despite the club being relegated?
questions.anchorClues: Eldin Jakupović saved three spot-kicks for Hull City in 2016–17, including penalties against Arsenal and Southampton.

questions.question: Who scored the first official goal at the new Tottenham Hotspur Stadium upon its opening in April 2019?
questions.anchorClues: Son Heung-min scored the inaugural goal at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium during a 2–0 victory against Crystal Palace on 3 April 2019.

questions.question: Which defender holds the Opta record for committing the most individual errors leading directly to an opposition goal in Premier League history (15 errors)?
questions.anchorClues: Sylvain Distin committed 15 errors directly leading to goals across 469 Premier League appearances for Manchester City, Portsmouth, Everton, and Bournemouth.
